provenance.use: TCP/fq EDT model; adapted, not wholesale patch applied
EDT packets must still honor fq maxrate

design.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC ns for new scheduling path, same clock as fq watchdog
design.timestamp: dedicated skb tcp_edt_ns; keep actual native microsecond skb_mstamp and legacy RTT/RTO/rate behavior
design.opt_in: TCP_CONG_EDT native flag, BBRv3 only; excluded from older BPF user flag mask
design.ordering: ordinary monotonic append O1; stable exceptional linear insert; untagged data retains FIFO across CC transitions; ACKs may bypass future EDT data; FIN uses data frontier
design.fallback: internal timer unchanged; forecasting only after FQ advertisement; live qdisc replace/nopacing transitions still need fresh connections and device validation
design.maxrate: skip duplicate socket-rate serialization but retain fq flow_max_rate
design.failure: only advance after successful handoff; outgoing clone stamped, retransmit queue original timestamps unchanged
design.copy: clone/GSO header copy plus IPv4/v6 fragment metadata; RX clears; cross-net scrub clears
design.deferred: No modern RTT subtraction, ECN_LOW,PLB,fast ACK,SO_TXTIME/UDP/NIC EDT offload or runtime qdisc replacement fix
design.control_and_CC_ordering: Pure ACK/SYN/RST no EDT; FIN follows data frontier. Untagged data retains FIFO when switching CC; initial NEEDED packet tagged before fq capability advertisement.
